protectedBranches.description: Branch names or wildcard patterns that should never be treated as cleanup candidates. Extends the built-in defaults (main, master, develop, dev).

includeCategories.description: Default categories to scan when no --include flag is provided.

stashAgeDays.description: Age threshold in days for flagging old stashes.

branchInactiveDays.description: Age threshold in days for flagging inactive branches.

divergedAheadCount.description: Minimum commits ahead of target for a branch to be considered significantly diverged.

divergedBehindCount.description: Minimum commits behind target for a branch to be considered significantly diverged.

branchExcludePatterns.description: Branch name patterns to exclude from cleanup candidates. Supports * wildcards.
